description: lookup_shards_with_ranges (shard_router.ex:233-248): start_key >= every shard end_key -> :ets.next returns :"$end_of_table", passed to :ets.prev -> ArgumentError. finalize_batch runs in Task.start_link from commit proxy server (server.ex:255) so the raise crashes the proxy; every transaction in the batch dies unanswered. Client-reachable: Tx.clear_range only guards s >= e; repro clear_range(<<0xFF,0xFF>>, <<0xFF,0xFF,0>>). Fix: handle the ETS edge (return [] -> storage_team_coverage_error, or clamp) + validate key ranges at commit-proxy ingress; add regression for {:error, {:storage_team_coverage_error, ...}} once reachable (finalization.ex:731 currently dead). Audit-confirmed in PR for bedrock-9n6.

comments.text: Crash fixed in b419aef0: lookup_shards_with_ranges returns [] for ranges entirely beyond shard coverage; finalization now surfaces {:error, {:storage_team_coverage_error, range}} and aborts clients instead of crashing the commit proxy. Regression tests at shard_router and finalization levels. REMAINING OPEN: commit-proxy ingress key validation (rejecting system-range keys at the door) is deliberately not addressed in PR #87 — larger design decision.

title: ShardRouter crashes commit proxy on ranges starting at/beyond last shard boundary
